Chapter 6630: Heaven Suppression Fist

Chapter 6630: Heaven Suppression Fist

“What about a scoop?” Grand Preceptor and the others needed this water because they were only one step away from becoming overlords.

This pure liquid could help them break through to the next realm. However, just one scoop would be far from enough. They needed a large amount so they glanced around, not wanting others to seize it.

“Boom!” Staff Ancestor arrived and forced them back.

“Lady, you must have this spring?” Grand Preceptor bowed and asked.

“Yes.” She casually responded.

“You are already an overlord, it has little effect on you.” The quiet Dugu Yuan spoke.

He was right. Others treasured it due to numerous effects such as longevity increase and curing potential. Most importantly, it could help them become overlords.

However, she was already an overlord so this seemed like a waste.

“I want it. Step aside.” She felt no need to explain herself. The only explanation was her being stronger than all of them.

She had no patience for their response and channeled her aura forward.

“Boom!” Just one step had the force of a galaxy against them. She took the second, third, and fourth...

They were horrified at the raw power of her movement and roared in response.

Grand Preceptor summoned his ancient dao; Godstallion closed his holy wings in front of him like armor; Jiu Ning moved her nine swords to the front...

These multiple layers crumbled one by one before her sheer power. They lasted the first but the second was several times stronger.

Others had an even worse time even though the power wasn’t directed at them. Primal ancestors and desolate gods were immobilized.

As for the group, their shouts and efforts made no difference. Grand Preceptor’s ancient dao crumbled, the same for his allies’ defenses. They spat out blood from the pressure.

“Fine, taste my fist!” Visceraless had enough and removed the leather glove from his right hand.

“Oh, this is bad!” Spectators shouted in horror.

“Rumble!” The world shook violently with the glove’s removal, revealing something capable of changing immortals’ expressions.

Staff Ancestor did not react to the empowered Light God using Mountaincutter. However, her expression changed upon seeing the fist. She didn’t dare to block it with her bare hands.
